text:
kevin: quick heads-up — PR #4521 updated the 429/time-limit section. editorial looks good but the Node SDK snippet now uses an obsolete field and fails lint.
maria: which snippet specifically?
kevin: the small example under 'client retries' — uses `retry_header` and a raw millisecond value. it breaks copy-paste for users.
sam: can you paste the exact block? i can submit a 1-line fix.
kevin: ```js
// from PR 4521
const resp = await client.generate({
  model: 'rwd-3-large',
  prompt: 'Summarize...',
  retry_header: { max_retries: 2, retry_after_ms: 150 },
});
```
ali: we should change to the canonical `retry_policy` object and call out that servers may return `Retry-After` (seconds) or our normalized `retry_after_ms`. add a note about parsing both.
maria: editorial note: also tighten language around "time limit" vs "timeout" — readers keep confusing the two. propose a 1-line definition and a tiny table (timelimit = server enforced token/time cap; timeout = client-side network deadline).
chris: i'll pick up the lint & code swap, and add a link to the error-ref page. which error-ref slug should we point to?
ali: use /docs/error-ref/429-rate-limit and also add the fallback behavior anchor (timelimit-fallbacks).
sam: should we also include a minimal exponential backoff snippet with jitter? i can draft a tiny pseudo-code example so we don't ship language-specific heavy code.
kevin: yes, keep it pseudo and short. prefer a 3-line example + link to the SDK's retry helpers.
maria: also request: add a one-sentence callout for dedicated capacity customers — "pin model or fall back to quantized variant" — that reduces the number of 429s in practice.
kevin: good. i also want a small QA trigger: add a smoke test with 3 prompts that hit the 429 path so future edits don't regress examples.
ali: i can add tests under docs/tests/429-smoketest with fixtures. will open follow-up PR and link it here.
maria: please don't duplicate examples we've already got in older threads; crosscheck 1799990001 (errref snippet) before adding. if it's similar, rephrase.
chris: acknowledged. timeline: aiming to merge PR #4521 with these fixes by EOD Friday. i'll do the code swap + link sweep today.
docs-bot: PR #4521 status: review requested -> chris; reviewers: maria, kevin.
sam: tiny nit — update the example's response handling to use `resp.retry_after_ms || resp.retry_after_secs*1000` so folks have a copy-paste-safe line.
kevin: yep add that one-liner and a short sentence about honoring `Retry-After` semantics.
maria: i'll follow up with editorial pass and the mini-table. thanks all :thumbsup: 
chris: ping me in-thread if you want me to pair for the smoke-test wiring.
kevin: thanks — i'll validate the built snippets locally after the patch is up.
